title: Inverse initial data for nonlinear Schrödinger equation via Carleman estimates and the contraction principle
summary: We study an inverse initial-data problem for a nonlinear Schrödinger equation in which the initial wave field is reconstructed from lateral measurements. Our approach combines a Legendre-polynomial-exponential-time dimensional reduction with a Carleman-based contraction principle. First, we expand the solution in a weighted Legendre basis in time and truncate the expansion to obtain a coupled nonlinear elliptic system for the spatial coefficients.
